product.name: Synthflow Voice AI Platform
product.description: A no-code, end-to-end platform for designing, testing, deploying, and managing AI voice agents for inbound and outbound customer conversations.

product.name: Enterprise Voice AI Deployment Services
product.description: Implementation and operational services that help enterprises move AI voice agents from design to production, including workflow configuration, testing, launch, monitoring, and ongoing optimization.

product.name: Synthflow Enterprise Telephony
product.description: An enterprise telephony service for routing and delivering AI-powered calls through Synthflow’s communications infrastructure or a customer’s existing carrier, SIP trunk, PBX, or contact-center system.

product.name: White-Label and Embedded Voice AI
product.description: A white-label offering that enables BPOs, CRM providers, SaaS companies, and other partners to embed branded AI voice automation into their own products or client services.
